top_signals.title: CFTC backs blockchain-based derivatives infrastructure as Backpack, tZERO win approvals
top_signals.summary: The CFTC has approved the first set of applications to establish regulated derivatives and exchange clearing operations that use blockchain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
